title: 7S.2c unknown nested TABLE diagnostic retained-byte accounting
scope: Account the bounded unknown-TABLE name prefixes and retained skip diagnostic under the shared DXF logical retained-byte budget.

change.summary: processTables reserves each retained unknown-table name prefix before copying, reserves the joined warning at its peak while those prefixes remain live, and transfers the charge to the operation budget only when the diagnostic is retained.
